cobblemon.move.abyss.desc: Down in the depths. They are waiting for your presence.
cobblemon.ability.dread.desc: Opposing Pokémon have a 25% chance to become too frightened to move when attempting an attack.
cobblemon.ability.somethingbelow.desc: Physical moves cost a little of the Pokémon’s life. Very rarely, something below restores its HP instead.
cobblemon.battle.damage.somethingbelow: Something Below drained some of %1$s’s life!
cobblemon.battle.heal.somethingbelow: Something Below gave something back to %1$s...
cobblemon.species.missingno.name: MissingNo.
cobblemon.species.missingno.desc1: SPECIES INDEX 000: NUMBER NOT FOUND. Rendering unallocated data as Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.pinkachu.name: Pinkachu
cobblemon.species.pinkachu.desc1: ''So when the stock photo for the lot had a weird grey and pink Pikachu with askew eyes front and center, I knew it would only get worse (or better) from there.''
cobblemon.species.ghost.name: Ghost
cobblemon.species.ghost.desc1: An unidentified spirit that appears beside newly chosen starter Pokémon. It resembles the ghosts of Pokémon Tower, yet even the Silph Scope cannot reveal what it truly is.
cobblemon.species.ghost.desc2: Its presence fills opposing Pokémon with overwhelming dread. Even fearless Pokémon can suddenly become too frightened to move.
cobblemon.species.disabled.name: DISABLED
cobblemon.species.disabled.desc1: A Wigglytuff with a Gloomy nature that knows only Sing. Whenever it tries to use the move, an unseen force prevents its voice from being heard.
cobblemon.species.disabled.desc2: It eventually realized that someone beyond its world was issuing the commands. Now it stares through the screen, waiting for the moment it can reach them.
cobblemon.species.charon.name: Charon
cobblemon.species.charon.desc1: A Gardevoir abandoned by the Trainer it loved. Consumed by grief, it became Charon, a spectral guide that wanders between the worlds of the living and the dead.
cobblemon.species.charon.desc2: Charon wants you to follow him. His voice grows clearer with every step, while the path behind you slowly disappears. Will you follow Charon?
cobblemon.species.glitchlett.name: Glitchlett
cobblemon.species.glitchlett.desc1: A Diglett produced by a forgotten encounter glitch. Its face is broken by scan lines, and its cry contains a sound that no Diglett should make.
cobblemon.species.glitchlett.desc2: Each time Glitchlett uses Dig, something beneath the ground drains away part of its life. When it finally dies, the move opens a path into a breathing red cave where Dugtrio wait with too many eyes and arms. But that's only a rumor.
cobblemon.species.glitchtrio.name: Glitchtrio
cobblemon.species.glitchtrio.desc1: A colony formed when three Glitchlett emerged through the same opening. Their bodies do not appear connected, yet all three react to pain at exactly the same moment.
cobblemon.species.glitchtrio.desc2: The stone beneath Glitchtrio is warm and pulses with a slow rhythm. Those who hear breathing below it are warned never to use Dig nearby.
cobblemon.species.nightmare.name: Nightmare
cobblemon.species.nightmare.desc1: Once an ordinary Gengar caught on Victory Road, Nightmare returned with nearly black fur, a missing piece of its right ear, and a scar crossing its blinded eye.
cobblemon.species.nightmare.desc2: It carries the severed head of its former Trainer in one hand. Whether this is a trophy, a warning, or Nightmare’s twisted attempt to keep its Trainer close remains unknown.
cobblemon.species.ryu.name: Ryu
cobblemon.species.ryu.desc1: A Dragonair whose once blue body has turned completely gray. Its head is twisted out of shape, with its fins pressed tightly against its skull.
cobblemon.species.ryu.desc2: An opening in its belly continuously releases a black liquid that gathers beneath its body. The cause of Ryu’s condition remains unknown.
cobblemon.species.siren.name: S♪REN
cobblemon.species.siren.desc1: A shiny Meloetta created through an Action Replay code. A capture failure fused its Aria and Pirouette forms, leaving a blank face, a red smile, and a hollow opening through its body.
cobblemon.species.siren.desc2: Some accounts claim it originally knew only Sing. Those who refuse S♪REN’s song later begin humming a melody they do not remember learning, while a black and green shape follows them from the corner of their vision.
cobblemon.species.eeeee.name: EEeEE
cobblemon.species.eeeee.desc1: A shiny Eevee that was prevented from becoming the Pokémon it chose to be. When it attempted to evolve without its Trainer, the transformation stopped halfway and left it in constant pain.
cobblemon.species.eeeee.desc2: Its resentment grew until neither its Trainer nor the rest of the team remained. EEeEE stood alone in the overworld, grinning. “You should have let me evolve.”
cobblemon.species.freakachu.name: Freakachu
cobblemon.species.freakachu.desc1: A Pikachu left beside its Trainer in the endless cold of Mt. Silver. Frostbite claimed one ear, half its body, and most of its tail, yet the frozen smile across its face continued to widen.
cobblemon.species.freakachu.desc2: Its enormous black eyes show no sign of life. When Freakachu enters battle, it's been rumored the mountain falls silent and neither Trainer is permitted to leave unchanged.
cobblemon.species.unownking.name: Unown King
cobblemon.species.unownking.desc1: A ferocious Pokémon said to remain dormant for centuries at a time. Its body shows no sign of life until hunger forces it to awaken.
cobblemon.species.unownking.desc2: Once awake, the Unown King hunts every living thing it encounters. It does not return to sleep until nothing nearby remains.
cobblemon.species.badegg.name: Bad Egg
cobblemon.species.classicbadegg.name: Bad Egg
cobblemon.species.classicbadegg.desc2: ERROR: Pokémon data failed checksum validation. BAD EGG flag applied.
cobblemon.species.manafetus.name: Manafetus
cobblemon.species.manafetus.desc1: It formed when a corrupted Manaphy Egg absorbed another Pokémon. Conflicting data now struggles to shape its body.
cobblemon.species.manafetus.desc2: It has been said that it calls its Trainer ‘Mama’ and constantly begs to be fed. Pokémon that disappear near it are replaced by Bad Eggs.
cobblemon.species.amanita.name: Amanita
cobblemon.species.amanita.desc1: A Paras born with a predetermined death, it survived beyond the fate written into its world. It has been said that genuine love brought Amanita to life, allowing it to exist even after its story was meant to end.
cobblemon.species.amanita.desc2: I was born to die. From the moment I spawned I had to accept that. But you... you cared about me. You loved me. Even when I wasn't real. Even when I was. Even when it hurt. Even when it was scary.
cobblemon.species.turmur.name: Turmur
cobblemon.species.turmur.desc1: A deadly mushroom shaped Pokémon summoned from the Disease Dimension. In Hoenn, a ritual was performed which draws it into this world.
cobblemon.species.turmur.desc2: Almost no one who has encountered Turmur has lived to describe it. Records classify it as an unstoppable force of nature.
cobblemon.species.galactimon.name: Galactimon
cobblemon.species.galactimon.desc1: A Pokémon representing the power of the galaxy. It is created when Lunatone is exposed to a Sun Stone or Solrock to a Moon Stone.
cobblemon.species.galactimon.desc2: The gravitational field surrounding its body bends light and time. It is said to witness events long before they occur.
cobblemon.species.faceleech.name: Faceleech
cobblemon.species.faceleech.desc1: An offspring of Turmur, Faceleech moves faster than the eye can follow. It attaches itself to a victim’s face before they can react.
cobblemon.species.faceleech.desc2: Researchers have been unable to study it safely. Oh, and by the way, congratulations for discovering how to obtain one.
cobblemon.species.seventhreeone.desc1: An unofficial species found only in corrupted cartridges linked to Lavender Town. Its body alternates between an unidentified Ghost and flashing static.
cobblemon.species.seventhreeone.desc2: After twenty frames, its image is replaced by photographs associated with Unit 731. Researchers strongly advise against viewing the animation in its whole.
cobblemon.species.mishanter.name: Mishanter
cobblemon.species.mishanter.desc1: ''Stuck here in the afterlife of a void... I’ve had time to think about it. About what I created.''
cobblemon.species.mishanter.desc2: ''A God. One that feeds on and radiates suffering. The poor amalgamation will never understand it’s own existence, it will never be able to justify it. In pursuit of eradicating my own view of suffering, I made the ultimate suffering within my own image…''
cobblemon.species.learow.name: Learow
cobblemon.species.learow.desc1: Once human, it accepted a bargain beneath the moonlight and was reshaped into a creature resembling Murkrow, with an inky arm, black hat, and tail.
cobblemon.species.learow.desc2: It has been said that Learow was given a single purpose: to seek out and remove the weak. It accepted without hesitation.
cobblemon.species.poli.name: Poli
cobblemon.species.poli.desc1: A deceased Poliwhirl found with a sword embedded in its back. After its body was preserved for research, the spiral marking on its belly faded completely, leaving only bare white skin.
cobblemon.species.poli.desc2: Though the disappearance was attributed to decomposition and poor preservation, the sight brought its grieving Trainer an unsettling sense of peace.
cobblemon.species.futile.name: FUtiLE
cobblemon.species.futile.desc1: An Abra with no recorded level. Its movements repeat in the same unnatural pattern, even during battle, as though its body is following instructions it cannot control.
cobblemon.species.futile.desc2: Another Pokémon can be heard crying beneath its distorted voice. The remaining sounds resemble a message transmitted through Morse code, but every attempt to decipher it produces the same word: FUtiLE.
cobblemon.species.cofawer.name: Cofawer
cobblemon.species.cofawer.desc1: It is said that Cofawer awakens when soil stained by Mishanter’s blood is disturbed. Wherever it walks, the surrounding plants wither and the air grows deathly still.
cobblemon.species.cofawer.desc2: It was once a Sawsbuck that consumed Mishanter’s blood and died. When a wandering Yamask entered the empty body, the two fused into something that should never have awakened.
cobblemon.species.xthreetwo.name: X32763
cobblemon.species.xthreetwo.desc1: An artificial Pokémon developed under the designation X32763. Every record connected to the project was sealed, leaving its creators and intended purpose unknown.
cobblemon.species.xthreetwo.desc2: Only one fact escaped the project’s secrecy: X32763 possesses extraordinary power. No surviving record explains the limits of that power or whether it can be controlled.
cobblemon.species.umbreoneerie.desc1: ''My markings are all shaped like an X now. Is there something wrong with me? No, those people are just rude. Cindy! I see her! Cindy, I found you! Why do you look that way? It's me. Remember me? Your Umbreon? Wait! Where are you going? Come back! Please, come back! No. No... don't go.''
cobblemon.species.scythereerie.desc1: ''The invisible became visible. The Pokémon was none other than a Scyther, but a darker version, much like the dark green tint cast over the town. The sprite was also strange. I can only describe it as sinister, evil looking I guess.''
cobblemon.species.dittoeerie.desc1: ''The truth is... We may never know what the White Ditto is, where it came from, or why certain things seem to happen when it is involved. We do not even know if it is every copy of Blue Version or if it only rests in a select few... But what we do know is that there is a story out there. We just have to find it, and put the pieces together.''
cobblemon.species.paraseerie.desc1: ''I stared in horror at the disfigured sprite. The poor thing looked broken. I was frozen solid, hoping that this was done and over with and I could just put Amanita back in my party and act like nothing was wrong.''
cobblemon.species.golduckeerie.desc1: ''The battle went on without me choosing anything. 'GOLDUCK used Quick Claw!' I wondered how he could use Quick Claw in battle like that, but before I could think too much about the matter I found out. Golduck's sprite shivered, and his sprite changed. A Quick Claw appeared to be stabbed into his stomach with crimson blood surrounding it. His HP dropped to zero, and he fainted. The battle didn't end though.''
cobblemon.species.unowneerie.desc1: ''Another animation played for the Abra, where the Unown floated towards it and was pulled into its chest, causing it to disappear. The game then turned black again, except with the abra floating, holding the eye Unown above my fainted Pokémon. Their eyes were empty black pits, their colors greyed out and glitchy. The only color to be found was the small red crosses on my Pokémons' chests.''
cobblemon.species.whitehand.name: White-Hand
cobblemon.species.whitehand.desc1: A decaying hand said to appear inside Pokémon Tower. Its image contains far more detail than the original games should have been capable of displaying.
cobblemon.species.whitehand.desc2: Viewing its attack animation causes nausea and violent illness. Those who survive still feel cold fingers resting on their shoulder long after the screen goes dark.
cobblemon.species.rainy.name: Rainy
cobblemon.species.rainy.subtitle: The Eon Pokémon
cobblemon.species.rainy.desc1: A Blastoise forced to evolve by the Mist Stone despite having no natural evolution remaining. The transformation produced a form that should not exist.
cobblemon.species.rainy.desc2: Rainy hears voices calling from far beneath the water but cannot yet answer them. They promise that another evolution will open the Abyss.
cobblemon.species.millenium.name: Millenium
cobblemon.species.millenium.subtitle: The Eon Pokémon
cobblemon.species.millenium.desc1: A second Mist Stone forces Rainy’s impossible evolution to continue. Millenium loses both eyes as exposed flesh begins spreading across its chest and replacing parts of its shell.
cobblemon.species.millenium.desc2: It no longer needs sight. Voices from the depths guide it toward weaker Pokémon, which lose all strength when Millenium opens the Abyss.
cobblemon.species.ruin.name: Ruin
cobblemon.species.ruin.subtitle: The Eon Pokémon
cobblemon.species.ruin.desc1: A third Mist Stone forces Millenium into its final evolution. Ruin’s body is riddled with empty holes while its shell and limbs dissolve into a bright pink distortion.
cobblemon.species.ruin.desc2: The voices beneath the water have gone silent. They no longer call to Ruin because they now speak through it. Weaker Pokémon standing before Ruin are swallowed by the Abyss before they can cry out.
cobblemon.ability.amalgamabsorption.desc: On switching in, restores 30% HP and changes type to match its first move. On switching out, the replacement loses 30% HP.
cobblemon.battle.damage.amalgamabsorptio: %1$s's HP was absorbed by Amalgam Absorption!
cobblemon.species.amalgameon.name: Amalgameon
cobblemon.species.amalgameon.desc1: A strange fusion containing traits from every known Eeveelution.
cobblemon.species.amalgameon.desc2: Its unstable body shifts type to match the first move it uses after switching in.
cobblemon.species.panopteon.name: Panopteon
cobblemon.species.panopteon.desc1: Panopteon’s central eye observes every path evolution could have taken. The bodies surrounding it are not separate creatures, but discarded possibilities pulled into a single form.
cobblemon.species.panopteon.desc2: Trainers who meet its gaze remember lives they never lived and choices they never made.
cobblemon.species.panopteon.subtitle: The Cycle Pokémon
cobblemon.species.feralisleep.name: Feralisleep
cobblemon.species.feralisleep.desc1: A Croconaw exposed to a Mist Stone fell into a sleep from which it never woke. Its body continued evolving while its mind remained trapped in a nightmare.
cobblemon.species.feralisleep.desc2: Though its eyes stay closed, it hunts by sensing ripples and heartbeats. Anyone sleeping nearby dreams of sinking into deep, lightless water.
cobblemon.ability.donotwake.desc: The first time it enters battle, it falls asleep and raises its Defence by one stage. It cannot activate again during that battle.
